properties.displayName: UAV S33 - Firmware Supply Chain Tampering (Preflight Hash/SBOM)
properties.description: UAV 펌웨어 공급망 변조 탐지. preflight_check 감사 이벤트에서 해시 불일치(HashMatch=false), 금지 SBOM 컴포넌트(SbomForbiddenCount>0), preflight 실패(Passed=false), 또는 제출된 이미지 해시가 Approved_Firmware_Hash_List에 없는 경우를 탐지. CorroborationScore(0~3)로 신뢰도 산출 — 해시 불일치/금지 SBOM/승인목록 미포함은 단독으로도 High 근거. MITRE: T1195, T1693, T1495
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 1d;
let ApprovedHashes = _GetWatchlist('Approved_Firmware_Hash_List') | project Hash;
UAVPgse_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| extend isUnapprovedHash = ImageHashSubmitted !in (ApprovedHashes)
| where HashMatch == false or SbomForbiddenCount > 0 or Passed == false or isUnapprovedHash
| extend TriggerReason = case(
    HashMatch == false and SbomForbiddenCount > 0, "HashMismatch_And_ForbiddenSBOM",
    HashMatch == false, "FirmwareHash_Mismatch",
    SbomForbiddenCount > 0, "Forbidden_SBOM_Component",
    isUnapprovedHash, "Firmware_Hash_Not_In_ApprovedList",
    "Preflight_Failed"
)
| extend CorroborationScore =
      toint(HashMatch == false)
    + toint(SbomForbiddenCount > 0)
    + toint(Passed == false)
    + toint(isUnapprovedHash)
| extend ConfidenceLevel = case(
    CorroborationScore >= 2, "High",
    CorroborationScore == 1, "Medium",
    "Low"
)
| extend DetectionDetail = strcat(
    "HashMatch:", HashMatch,
    "|SbomForbiddenCount:", SbomForbiddenCount,
    "|Passed:", Passed,
    "|UnapprovedHash:", tostring(isUnapprovedHash),
    "|Serial:", Serial
)
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    UAVId,
    TriggerReason,
    ConfidenceLevel,
    CorroborationScore,
    DetectionDetail,
    Operator,
    Serial,
    ImageHashSubmitted,
    ImageHashExpected,
    SbomForbiddenCount,
    StatusCode
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S33 - Firmware Supply Chain Tampering - {{UAVId}} [{{TriggerReason}}]
